title: Hogaya Tukdey Badan Nousha ka
body:
Kehtey they roo kar ye shah e Karbala
<<MINI>>
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Zulm ki fouj o mei o bhagar machi hogayi
Paamal dulhan ki khushi paara paara
Maa ka har aarmaa huwa hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<MINI>>
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. They paye zulm o sitam bandhey kamar ek yateemoo
Gul badan ko ghair kar asqiya ne woh sitam
<<MINI>>
Ran me kiya hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jab khiyaam e shah me pahunchi khaber
Hogaye sare barati nouhagar
Masnad e shaadi bani farshe aza
<<MINI>>
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dhoond thi thi char su maa ki nazer
Hai kahan kis haal me mera pisar
Kehta tha chader se khoo ristha huwa hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
5. Shidatey gham se tha yeh haal e dulhan
Biyah ka joda bhi lagta tha kafan
Kamsini me daag yeh kaisa mila
<<MINI>>
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tha kahan Yawar wo Qasim ka badan
Shakal me tukdey ki tha qalb e Hassan
Thi lagan ki jaa shahedeen ki aaba
<<MINI>>
Hogaya tukdey badan nousha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
